title: Predicting cross-species affinity retention after humanization

cases.study_information: Each molecule is an anti-IL-2Rbeta VHH in the same one-armed VHH-Fc format. The VHH-Fc molecules were captured on an anti-PGLALA CM3 surface. Recombinant human or cynomolgus IL-2Rbeta-gamma extracellular-domain constructs were injected as analytes in a Biacore T200 assay at 25 C, using PBS-P+ buffer, a top receptor concentration of 150 nM and threefold serial dilutions. Association and dissociation were monitored for 240 s and 600 s, respectively; KD values were reported from a 1:1 Langmuir fit and are in nM. Predict ratios of the reported matched SPR KD values. The source does not provide replicate-level uncertainty for these table entries.

output_format: One comma-separated line containing every target exactly once, in the requested order; no explanation.
target_antigen: anti-IL-2Rbeta specificity; matched human/cynomolgus IL-2Rbeta-gamma ECD analytes
